jobs.name: sun
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated weather game sprite asset on a truly TRANSPARENT background, for a cozy tiny fantasy potion shop that floats over a desktop with no rectangular game background. Genuine coarse low-resolution PIXEL ART consistent with 48x64 character sprites, 1 logical pixel dark muted plum outline, clean chunky square pixel clusters, limited 3-4 tone palette per material, nearest-neighbor appearance, no antialiasing, no gradients, no glow haze. Warm gentle storybook fantasy feeling. The object must read clearly over BOTH dark and light desktop windows: restrained dark-plum outline on bright shapes, a lighter visible upper edge on dark shapes. Complete uncropped object centered with transparent margin. NO ground, NO sky backdrop, NO scenery, NO label/text/UI, NO character face, NO emoji expression, NO watermark, NO other weather symbols unless specifically requested. This is an individual importable sprite, NOT a sheet or contact board. DAY / CLEAR SKY SUN ONLY. A small round warm pale-gold sun disk with 8 short chunky golden sun rays, cozy buttery yellow center, amber lower edge. Very simple and readable at 24x24 logical pixels. No cloud, no moon, no stars, no face, no halo. All eight rays discrete bold pixel shapes, no long thin spiky rays.
